headline: Last session: Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000 led by banking and pharmaceutical gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Strong performance in the banking and pharmaceutical sectors led the market higher
A correction in global oil prices provided support to Indian equities
Larsen & Toubro secured a major infrastructure order for the Noida Metro Aqua Line extension
Indices recovered from early profit-taking to settle in positive territory
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today, November 10, 2026, for a scheduled NSE trading holiday
In the last session, the Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,000 level after a dip in previous trading
The Sensex ended Monday's session over 100 points higher, closing above the 81,000 mark
PSU bank stocks were among the primary gainers during Monday's range-bound trading session
summary: Indian markets are closed today for an NSE holiday following a positive close in the previous session. On Monday, the Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000, driven by gains in banking and pharma sectors. L&T stood out after securing a significant metro rail order worth up to ₹2,500 crore.
